meta.title: 병렬구조
meta.note: 교재 p.70~71과 정답·해설 p.50의 대표 Q01~Q04 원문·정답 논리를 대조해 병렬구조 중심의 대표 source-aligned QA 세트로 변환함.

items.sentence: In order for a great company to satisfactorily serve the public, it must have a philosophy and a method of doing business which will allow and ensure that its people serve the public in an efficient and pleasing manner.
items.prompt: which 뒤에서 that절을 공통으로 목적어로 취하는 두 동사를 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: will allow and ensure가 병렬이며 두 동사가 뒤의 that its people serve ...를 공통으로 연결합니다.
items.memory: 등위접속사 앞뒤가 같은 문법 역할인지 확인

items.sentence: In order for a great company to satisfactorily serve the public, it must have a philosophy and a method of doing business which will allow and ensure that its people serve the public in an efficient and pleasing manner.
items.prompt: in an ___ and pleasing manner에 알맞은 형태를 고르세요.
items.explanation: pleasing과 병렬로 manner를 수식해야 하므로 형용사 efficient가 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: Prejudice is an idea based on an irrational generalization about a group that is applied indiscriminately or inflexibly with little regard for facts, and this can lead to hostility and discrimination.
items.prompt: applied indiscriminately or ___에서 알맞은 형태를 고르세요.
items.explanation: 동사 is applied를 수식하는 부사 indiscriminately와 병렬이므로 inflexibly가 알맞습니다.

items.sentence: Cooking opened up whole new vistas of edibility by rendering various ingredients more digestible and overcoming many of the chemical defenses which can be fatal to humans.
items.explanation: 전치사 by의 목적어로 rendering과 overcoming이 and로 병렬 연결됩니다.

items.sentence: A scientifically-minded person would think astrologers are wrong, seeing that their evidence can't be measured by scientific methodology or that astrological papers have shown that astrology has no significant predictive value.
items.prompt: seeing 뒤에서 or로 병렬 연결된 두 that절을 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: that their evidence can't be measured by scientific methodology
that astrological papers have shown that astrology has no significant predictive value
items.explanation: seeing의 목적어 역할을 하는 두 that절이 or로 병렬 연결됩니다.
